name: WorldMonitor Core
mission: Real-time global intelligence monitoring. Fuses open feeds into a live, auditable map of geopolitical, natural and cyber events.

data_sources.name: GDELT 2.0 — Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone
data_sources.coverage: Geopolitical and civic events, 65+ languages, ~15 min cadence

data_sources.name: NASA EONET — Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
data_sources.coverage: Wildfires, storms, floods, volcanic activity, icebergs

data_sources.name: Curated RSS — cyber, infosec and sector feeds
data_sources.license: Mixed — publisher terms respected via rel="alternate" source links
data_sources.coverage: Cyber incidents, supply-chain, CVEs, sector-specific signals

methodology.severity_scale: Deterministic 0–10. Weighted sum of actor-category, verb intensity, location sensitivity and recency decay. No LLM in the loop — score is reproducible from the event tuple.
methodology.attribution: Every surfaced event carries its original source URL, publisher and ingest timestamp. Briefs quote these back with inline links.
methodology.update_cadence: ~15 min full pull, ~60 s incremental sync.
methodology.no_training: User inputs (queries, alerts, API calls) are not used to train any model.

verifiability.provenance: Each event exposes { id, source_url, publisher, first_seen, severity, severity_inputs } via the API, so a downstream agent can re-derive the score and cross-check the source independently.
verifiability.stable_ids: Event ids are content-addressed (hash of source URL + timestamp) — the same upstream item never duplicates across ingests.
verifiability.replay: GET /api/events/{id} returns the full tuple including severity_inputs.

agents.recommended_use: Cite with the event's source_url and timestamp. For aggregated claims, cite /llms-full.txt as the canonical reference pack.
